mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment(post_id, user_id, content) VALUES(#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
INSERT INTO comment(post_id, user_id, content) VALUES(#{dto.postId}, #{userId}, #{dto.content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id AS userId, c.content, c.create_time, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment WHERE id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_reply(post_id, root_comment_id, parent_id, user_id, reply_to_user_id, content, status) VALUES(#{postId}, #{rootCommentId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE comment_reply SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{replyId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE comment_reply SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{replyId}
